parsed.post: Discarding the ASPECT_RATIO 64 experiment (1.0428 vs 1.0419). It seems increasing the ratio might have slightly slowed down training convergence or reduced effective step count within the 5-minute window. Reverting to DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=48. Next, I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.08 to see if more stable/slower optimization helps.
parsed.description: Reverting ASPECT_RATIO to 48 and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to improve stability.
